title: Sparring 1:1 prep — Lucy Bennett (engineer report)
content:
Context: quick pre-1:1 scribbles for Wednesday with my direct report (engineer on serving-runtime). Goal is to (a) unblock them, (b) push one small technical win this sprint, (c) check career cadence and energy. Keep it ~30m.

Meeting length: 30m (10m updates, 15m deep/coach, 5m actions)
Location: Zoom / async notes in this doc

Top signals to watch (data snapshot):
- PR queue: 6 open, median review age 48h (target <24h)
- Canary failures last 7d: 2 flakies (rerun fixed), one latency spike in region-eu on model-x-v2 (+18% p50)
- Throughput SLO: currently 98.7% under 150ms target, trending slightly down after quantization rollout

Agenda (rough):
1) Quick mood + top thing they want help on (2–3m)
2) Blocker triage: permissions for infra testing, perf regression root cause (10m)
3) Sparring (deep): tradeoffs for cache eviction policy + rollout plan (10–12m)
4) Career check: recent ownership, stretch project interest, feedback loop (4m)
5) Action items + align on next sync (1–2m)

Notes to self / prompts to use:
- "What would unblock you if I could only move one thing before EOD?"
- Use the tension map: urgency vs. impact to help prioritize cache work vs. infra permission cleanup.
- Ask for summary in one sentence of the perf hypothesis and what evidence would falsify it.
- Coach on communication: show me the shortest note they'd send to SRE to request ephemeral test quota.

Blockers I already know about (to verify):
- Need infra-team approval for additional on-demand nodes (ticket JIRA-1987)
- Missing perf counters in nightly runs (todo: enable full telemetry for model-x-v2)
- PR bottleneck: reviewer availability (Arun is tagged — check load)

Hypothesis for latency spike:
- Primary: quantized kernel selection falling back to slower path for long sequence lengths in EU region due to different request distribution.
- Quick checks to run: 1) repro with EU sample batch locally (ask them to paste sample queries), 2) confirm kernel selection logs on canary, 3) compare sequence length histogram between NA and EU.

Sparring focus (cache eviction policy):
- option A: LRU with TTL (simple, predictable)
- option B: LFU with occasional decays (better for long-lived prefixes, more complex)
- option C: hybrid: small fast LRU + background analytics to promote hot keys to long-cache pool
- Decision heuristics: operator complexity, memory cost, tail-latency effects, rollout rollback safety
- Quick experiment plan: rollout option A to 10% traffic on dedicated pool, measure p50/p95 and hit-rate delta after 24–48h

Career thread (check-ins):
- Review last quarter ownership: they led zstd quantization tuning and drove a small cost reduction (good to call out).
- Ask about interest in small outward-facing project (docs + runbook for cache ops) — good stretch assignment for mentorship.
- Feedback I want to give: stronger PR descriptions (context + risk + rollback) — give one concrete example from latest PR.

Action-items (capture during meeting — tentative):
- A1: Lucy to paste EU sample query set link here and run local repro by Fri 2026-10-08. (owner: direct report)
- A2: I (manager) to escalate JIRA-1987 to infra lead and request short-term quota by Thu 2026-10-06. (owner: Lucy Bennett / manager)
- A3: Add kernel-selection debug logging to canary pipeline — small PR (max 1 day). (owner: direct report)
- A4: Short doc: proposed cache eviction plan (1-pager) due Tue 2026-10-12. We'll review in sync. (owner: direct report)
- A5: I will pair-review next PR and give explicit checklist for release notes + rollback plan (owner: manager)

Follow-ups to record after the meeting:
- Capture one-sentence decision for cache policy and pin experiment percentage.
- Update JIRA with expected outcomes for experiment and monitoring dashboard links.
- Schedule 20m post-experiment review.

Misc scratch (notes-to-self):
- If they seem burnt out: propose 50% focus on operational wins + 50% on growth (mentorship, doc ownership)
- Bring up internal recognition (monthly shoutouts) if they shipped the cost win but haven't been credited.
- Remember to ask: "Is anything blocking your ability to mentor junior engineers?"

Quick template to paste in meeting notes (for report to copy):
"Summary: I ran a short repro with EU sample set; kernel A fell back to slow path when seq_len > 1024. Experiment: enable LRU-TTL at 10% for 48h to validate hit-rate change and p95 latency. Action: follow up with metrics dashboard link (link)."

End of prep. Keep this doc updated with the meeting transcript + finalized action items after the 1:1.
